description: Source code for LwM2M JSON read/write operations in Zephyr OS, including JSON parsing, encoding, and resource handling functions.

methods.name: init_object_name_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the resource name string based on the resource path.

methods.name: number_to_string
methods.description: Converts a formatted number to string using vsnprintk.

methods.description: Converts a double value to string representation.

methods.name: objlnk_to_string
methods.description: Converts object link structure to string.

methods.name: json_add_separator
methods.description: Adds a comma separator in JSON output if needed.

methods.name: json_postprefix
methods.description: Sets the output flags after writing a JSON object.
